own_solution.law: Hagen–Poiseuille flow gives Q = pi*r^4*rho*g*h/(8*eta*Lc). Volume conservation gives A*dh/dt = -Q, hence t = [8*eta*Lc*A/(pi*rho*g*r^4)]*ln(h0/h1). The time constant is 2138.64 s, giving t = 1005.17 s = 16.7528 min.
assumptions: The oil obeys the constant-viscosity Newtonian Poiseuille model.
Flow is quasi-steady as the oil level falls.
Hydrostatic pressure supplies the stated pressure difference, with the specified neglected effects.
A current top-up changes the starting depth to 40 cm plus the added depth.
